messages:
Nadia Park: Hi team  Nadia here (she/they). First day in Product Ops! Moving from Chicago to SF this week and Im officially carrying three succulents and an emergency jar of pickles. Happy to be here :wave:

welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Nadia! Your onboarding checklist and welcome lunch invite are in your email. If you need a desk plant watering buddy, ping #new-hires. :seedling:

Ishaan Kumar: Welcome Nadia! Im in Product Ops too. If youre bringing plants, beware of the office spider plant that eats small succulents. Also pickles are a hill I will die on. Wheres your favorite sandwich spot so we can do a quick lunch run?

Nadia Park: Thanks Ishaan! Sandwich hill: any place with an avocado smash. Also Im allergic to cilantro (the betrayal), so no salsa-heavy options.

Bea Lopez: Welcome! I run the onboarding lunch rota. We usually do a 12:30 group by the big whiteboard. Todays snack theme is international cookies. If youre in office, well save you a cookie. :cookie:

Sam Pizza: Hey Nadia, welcome aboard. If your plants need a quarantine space, I can keep them on my desk for a day. Also pro tip: slap a Post-it on anything you dont want borrowed (mugs, succulents, pickles).

Facilities: Hi Nadia  Facilities here. If you need moving boxes or help with a temporary storage spot while you settle in, we have a handful in Mail Room 2. Also badge pickup is at reception, 9-5.

Nadia Park: Thank you all  adore the cookie theme and the plant rescue offers. Ill be in tomorrow morning with a small army of succulents and one very dramatic jar of pickles. Looking forward to meeting people in person! :smile: 

Bea Lopez: See you tomorrow! Well put your name on a cookie and save you a chair. 

Ishaan Kumar: Bring pickles, receive friends. Also office plant trade after lunch? I have a mysterious fern.

Facilities: Quick note: leftover unlabeled food is cleared Fridays at 5pm. If pickles are precious, label them with your name.

Nadia Park: Noted. Labeling imminent. Thanks for the warm reception everyone!
